messages.subject: Re: Error in get_sampleReadsRaw_from_SeqLib(useSoftClippedBases = useSoftClippedBases
parts:
Hey,

Thanks for the message. So it looks like the variables "chrStart" and "chrEnd" are not being set properly (these variables tell STITCH where to start and stop reading the BAM). They are set in the function "initialize_chrStart_and_chrEnd" which sets "chrStart" based on the minimum position seen in the "posfile" in the region of interest, and similarly for chrEnd. I'm wondering if there are no SNPs in the imputation region? This would make sense given the warning message above. If this is the case I need to make STITCH throw better errors

Can you try running the following in R and let me know what you get

pos <- read.table("pos500.txt", header = FALSE, sep = "\t")
dim(pos)
range(pos[, 2], na.rm = TRUE)
range(pos[, 2], na.rm = FALSE)
L <- as.integer(as.character(pos[, 2]))
buffer=250000 
regionStart=130000001
regionEnd=140000000
sum( ((regionStart - buffer) <= L) & (L < regionStart)) ## left region
sum( (regionStart <= L) & (L <= regionEnd)) ## interior region
sum( (regionEnd < L) & (L <= (regionEnd + buffer))) ## right region

Thanks,
Robbie
